Hi Aditya,

Quick logistics ask as we lock down the onsite week: can you confirm who at Redwood will be our onsite liaison for check-in and badge pickup at Helix HQ (San Francisco)? Our security desk requires the liaison's full name and phone number 48 hours in advance.

Also our IT team requests an AV rehearsal window and vendor contact for the morning of Oct 26 (preferred 08:30–09:30 local). If Redwood can provide a point-of-contact for AV/rooms + a backup virtual dial-in plan (we have a handful of participants dialing from EMEA), that would help with our run-of-show planning.

Tom and I will circulate a final attendee roster by EOD Wed. Thanks — appreciate the help getting this ironed out.

Best,
Julie Park
Program Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Helix Financial
[julie.park@helixfin.com | +1 415-555-0126]

Hi Julie — thanks for the heads up. Quick answers and next steps below. Attaching a draft run-of-show and a badge request CSV for Helix security to pre-load.

Onsite liaison: Priyom Das (priyom.das@redwood.ai, +1 628-555-0199). He will meet your team at the security desk and escort Redwood staff to the 8th-floor conference center. Priyom will be the point for parking pass pickup as well (see pickup instructions below).

AV rehearsal: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) will own AV. Proposed slot: Oct 26, 08:30–09:00 PT for a quick mic/check and presentation load. If we need extended time, we can stretch to 09:30. Laura — please confirm.

Virtual fallback: we’ll provide a Google Meet dial-in + phone bridge for EMEA. Proposed cross-region overlap windows for live demos: 09:30–11:00 PT (12:30–14:00 ET / 17:30–19:00 CET). If Helix needs earlier/later windows for APAC participants, flag and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: [Attachment: onsite_run_of_show_v1.pdf (PDF), badge-requests.csv (CSV)]

- Redwood liaison (Priyom Das) to pick up pre-printed visitor badges at Lobby Security between 7:45–08:15 on Oct 27.
- List of visitors should match badge-requests.csv exactly.
- For vendor access (AV crew), please ensure the vendor company name is allowed on the day pass (we’ve listed 'Acme AV Services' in the attached CSV).

Next: Laura to confirm AV contact + rehearsal window; Priyom will share arrival ETA and mobile for day-of.

Thanks,

- Parking passes will be available in the security office. Redwood liaison can collect between 7:30–8:15 on Oct 27. Please bring a photo ID for pickup.
- Freight entrance is fine for AV unload; Miguel should check in with Facilities on arrival (dock code sent via separate channel).
- For EMEA participants dialing in, phone bridge + Google Meet is fine. We have two people in London who will join the demo window you proposed.

We will forward the finalized headcount by EOD Wednesday and upload the official visitor CSV to our internal vendor portal. Looking forward to the rehearsal on the 26th.

~Tom
